hints.tr: `pattern` yedi satırlı bir seri; indeksi 0–6. `pattern - pattern.mean()` toplamı sıfıra çekiyor.
hints.en: `pattern` is a series of seven rows indexed 0–6. `pattern - pattern.mean()` pulls the sum to zero.

hints.tr: `pattern.loc[s.index.dayofweek]` her tarih için o günün payını seçiyor; `.values` ile indeksini atıp serinin tarihlerine bağlıyorsun.
hints.en: `pattern.loc[s.index.dayofweek]` picks that day's share for every date; with `.values` you drop its index and attach the dates of the series.

hints.tr:
Çözüm:

```python
import pandas as pd

s = pd.read_csv("store_sales.csv", index_col="date", parse_dates=True)["sales"]
s = s.asfreq("D")

trend = s.rolling(7, center=True).mean()

detrended = s - trend
pattern = detrended.groupby(detrended.index.dayofweek).mean()
pattern = pattern - pattern.mean()
print(pattern.round(1).tolist())

seasonal = pd.Series(pattern.loc[s.index.dayofweek].values, index=s.index)

resid = s - trend - seasonal
print(round(float(resid.std()), 2), round(float(s.std()), 2))

day = "2024-03-12"
print(int(s.loc[day]), round(float(trend.loc[day]), 1),
      round(float(seasonal.loc[day]), 1), round(float(resid.loc[day]), 1))

print(bool((trend + seasonal + resid - s).abs().max() < 1e-9))
```

import pandas as pd

s = pd.read_csv("store_sales.csv", index_col="date", parse_dates=True)["sales"]
s = s.asfreq("D")

trend = s.rolling(7, center=True).mean()

pattern = detrended.groupby(detrended.index.dayofweek).mean()
pattern = pattern - pattern.mean()
print(pattern.round(1).tolist())

seasonal = pd.Series(pattern.loc[s.index.dayofweek].values, index=s.index)

resid = s - trend - seasonal
print(round(float(resid.std()), 2), round(float(s.std()), 2))

day = "2024-03-12"
print(int(s.loc[day]), round(float(trend.loc[day]), 1),
      round(float(seasonal.loc[day]), 1), round(float(resid.loc[day]), 1))

print(bool((trend + seasonal + resid - s).abs().max() < 1e-9))
